g.text: Full-scope prompt engineer · backtests every plan
Calendar CC: pull from HubSpot deal owners,
or use a static team list when no deal exists?
CRM note: include the raw Meet URL, or link
the slot booked with the rest of the team?
"...so when a deal moves to Closed Won, auto-schedule a follow-up two weeks out and run the same 12-model backtest before sending..."
